description: This source file implements a Roslyn analyzer named GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzer for C# projects. Its purpose is to analyze specific syntax nodes related to interface, class, struct, record, and record struct declarations to identify those missing certain custom attributes, particularly focusing on 'alias' attributes and their association with grain interfaces and classes within the Orleans framework. It provides diagnostics related to the usage of alias and serializer attributes to enforce conventions or highlight missing annotations.

classes.name: GenerateAliasAttributesAnalyzer
classes.description: A diagnostic analyzer class for C# source code that ensures proper use of alias and serializer attributes in Orleans grain interfaces and classes.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Registers syntax node actions for analyzing specific C# syntax kinds related to interface, class, struct, record, and record struct declarations.

methods.name: CheckSyntaxNode
methods.description: Performs analysis on syntax nodes to determine whether they require diagnostics based on attribute presence and inheritance, focusing on Orleans grain interfaces and classes.

methods.name: GetArity
methods.description: Calculates the nesting level (arity) of a type declaration, accounting for nested types.

methods.name: GetNamespaceAndNesting
methods.description: Builds a fully qualified namespace and nesting string for a given type declaration syntax node.

methods.name: ReportFor
methods.description: Generates and reports a diagnostic message with related properties about a type declaration that is missing certain attributes.
